o.text:
Etymology tree
Arabic حَيَوَان (ḥayawān)bor.
Classical Persian حَیْوَان (haywān)bor.
Azerbaijani heyvan
Borrowed from Classical Persian حَیْوَان (haywān), borrowed from Arabic حَيَوَان (ḥayawān).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آرد (ard).
Borrowed from Classical Persian طرفدار (tarafdār). By surface analysis, tərəf + -dar.

From Proto-Turkic *kiĺčin(e)-.
Compare Turkish kişnemek, Southern Altai киште- (kište-, “to neigh”), Bashkir and Tatar кешнәү (keşnäw), Yakut кистээ (kistee, “to neigh”), Chuvash кӗҫӗн (kĕś̬ĕn).
Borrowed from Persian رصدخانه. By surface analysis, rəsəd + -xana.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish دپه كوز (däpä göz). By surface analysis, təpə + göz.
